annotation.title_clean: Part 746—Embargoes and Other Special Controls (15 CFR Part 746)
annotation.title_en: Part 746—Embargoes and Other Special Controls (15 CFR Part 746)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bureau of Industry and Security, U.S. Department of Commerce
annotation.summary_en: US Export Administration Regulations Part 746 setting embargoes and sanctions-based export licensing controls for Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea, Iraq, Russia, Belarus and occupied Ukrainian regions, with license exceptions, review policies and HTS-coded item supplements. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: License required for nearly all items to Cuba, Syria, and North Korea, with narrow exceptions
Russia/Belarus licensing for CCL items, foreign direct product rules, and listed industrial and luxury goods
Global Export Control Coalition countries excluded from certain requirements
Policy of denial generally, with case-by-case review for humanitarian, safety and similar uses
Supplements list HTS codes subject to Russia/Belarus controls
